items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: She like the way I played, so she kept me in the band there.

ctx.x: So, I went to Marg and gave her the note. So, Marg like the way I played. I don't know what I was doing -- I was just blowing. She like the way I played, so she kept me in the band there.
You say Marg was your sister?
